Glinting Hollow.intro: To get access, one must first complete the Glinting Hollow Key Quest.
travel: South - Next to a ramp between 2 Dryads and a tree. Carved into the surface is a single leaf, half-charred, half-golden. An inscription reads, 'What lingers longest is not life, but the echo of its passing.'
East - Up a ramp, over the bear cave where Hrask Spawns. The stone is ridden with ice fractures and feels brittle. An inscription reads, 'First bite of winter... sharp, sudden, and sure.'
West - Up a ramp overlooking the center platform. Carved into the stone's face is a sleeping bear coiled in ice. An inscription reads, 'Deep cold does not rage. It waits.'
Center - On the center platform. The stone is made of a stone gray slate, damp with condensation. An inscription reads, 'Between breath and silence, the veil thins.'

North - At the base of the ramp leading up to the East firepit. A hollow space in the center of the stone holds a single frozen tear. An inscription reads, 'Only when the world remembers its breath... may the heart be lit.'

Keeper's Bight.intro: Keeper's Bight is a coastal temperate forest plateau centrally located on Aêthoril's Western Coast in the Calafrey region. Transitioning from low coastal desert in the South to high forest plateau in the North. Penshaw, under the control of the Red Mantle, provides the region port access with popular shipping routes to Zaedin's Landing and ultimately Night Harbor. To the North is Evershade Weald, to the East is Scarwood, to the South is Vale of Zintar, to the West is Shallow Shoals. The Blacktide Orcs have a dominant foothold in the South while trapping and hunting are common throughout the thick forest plateau.

Vale of Zintar.intro: Vale of Zintar is a coastal desert situated on the West coast of Aêthoril in the Szuur region. To the North is Keeper's Bight, to the East is Glass Flats, to the South is Fallen Watch, to the West is Shallow Shoals. Giants and Giant Undead Skeletons are the dominant force but orcs have also make their pressence known. However, corruption from unknown sources spreads in the South. There is a Wizard Pyramid located in the South half of the zone.
